notes:
Context / pain: SMB e‑commerce platform. Signed up via self‑serve to add chat-based order help and quick returns summarization. POC started but they see inconsistent latency — 'sometimes chat api takes 900-1200ms per response, feels slow for live chat'. They're region-testing in us-east-1 (primary) and us-west-2 (fallback).

Customer constraints: cost sensitive (tight margins), wants <250ms p95 for single-turn chat where possible, but will accept 400-500ms for richer assistant responses. No on-prem or VPC planned right now — public cloud only. Security: SSO planned for admin console (Okta), basic audit logs needed for support tickets.

What they tried: reduced max_tokens, set streaming=false, shrank prompt by removing verbose system instructions -> saw modest gains. Tried targeting us-west-2 and saw slightly lower median but still large p95 spikes. Current timeout set at 10s on client; sometimes request fails with timeout before response completes (esp for >700 token outputs).

AE/SE notes & recommendations given on call: brainstormed region routing, encourage using nearby region to users; enable streaming to reduce perceived latency for chat UI; tune client timeout to 30s while optimizing prompt lengths; add token limits and incremental generation for long outputs; advise on shorter system messages and early stopping heuristics. Suggested caching frequent prefixes and using embeddings for rerank instead of generating long summaries.

POC ask: SE to run quick perf workshop next week (30–45m) to review traces and recommend 2 region choices, batching settings, and a prompt-length checklist. Customer wants a short one-page playbook they can hand to front-end engineers.

Direct quotes / customer tone: 'We love the API — but users notice the slowness. If we can get consistent sub-500ms live chat it's a go.'

Next steps (short):
- SE perf workshop (Diego) — target week of 2026-03-15
- Deliver region recommendation (primary + fallback) + timeout guidance (client/server)
- Share prompt-length best practices + checklist (1 pager)
- Add sample code snippet for streaming to improve perceived latency

Notes on potential upsell: if latency stabilizes and they commit to host 3M tokens/month, move to mid_market/dedicated evaluation. High chance to convert to monthly paid hosted plan if p95 improves and cost per token guidance provided.
